11-carly-kuhn.component: Global page layout — full-height right gutter
11-carly-kuhn.whatDiffers: The entire clone page body is confined to a ~1280px column pinned flush-LEFT, leaving a persistent blank vertical strip (~150-165px) down the whole RIGHT edge. On live everything spans the full 1440 viewport. This clips: the hero bedroom image (stops at ~1290 instead of full-bleed edge-to-edge), the Shop the Collection product grid and its heading divider rule (right rule ends ~1250 vs live ~1388), the 'Bringing the Vision to Life' right-hand image, the bottom lifestyle image + its 'THE CARLY KUHN COLLECTION / SHOP NOW' overlay (centered in the narrow image rather than the page), and most glaringly the dark FOOTER — its dark background itself stops ~160px short of the right edge, exposing a light strip beside the 5 footer columns. The sticky top bar and header are the only elements that reach full width, which makes the mismatch more obvious.
11-carly-kuhn.fixHint: The top-level content wrapper is ~1280px wide and left-aligned. Set it to full viewport width (width:100%; remove the fixed/left-pinned max-width, or center with margin:0 auto so it fills 1440). Ensure the full-bleed sections (hero image, bottom lifestyle image) and the footer's dark background use width:100% of the now-full wrapper (object-fit:cover for the images) so all sections and the footer bg extend to the right edge as on live.

14-guidance.whatDiffers: Below the full-width header, the clone's entire body (hero, 'Your Partner in Design' cards, swatch grid, 'Measure like a pro' dark section, and CTA+footer) is constrained to ~1280px and anchored to the LEFT edge, leaving a ~160px empty margin on the right. Full-bleed dark sections ('Measure like a pro', footer CTA) stop ~160px short of the right viewport edge, exposing a cream vertical strip. In live the same content is centered and full-bleed sections run edge-to-edge across the full 1440. This off-center wrapper also makes the clone ~700px shorter overall (images scale down in the narrower column).
14-guidance.fixHint: The main body wrapper is missing horizontal centering and/or has too-small a max-width. Set the content container to margin-inline:auto with the correct max-width (live content ~1300-1336px), and let the dark 'Measure like a pro' and footer/CTA sections span the full viewport width (100vw / full-bleed). The header is already correct, so scope the fix to the body wrapper only.

14-guidance.component: 'Which fabric is best for you?' swatch grid
14-guidance.whatDiffers: Each collection row (Everhem Hues, Everhem Essentials, Jake Arnold for Everhem) renders only 6 swatches; the 7th swatch is clipped or hidden — Juniper (Hues), Rose (Essentials), and Mist (Jake Arnold) are missing versus 7 shown per row in live. Row labels still say '7 fabrics'/'11 fabrics' but the rightmost column falls outside the narrowed container.
14-guidance.fixHint: Symptom of the narrowed left-anchored wrapper (finding 1): restoring the correct body width lets the 7-column grid fit. Verify grid-template-columns stays at 7 columns and the row does not overflow/clip the last swatch.

13-samples.component: Footer / "Your windows deserve this" CTA dark band
13-samples.whatDiffers: The dark background behind the CTA band and the footer stops at x≈1280 in the clone, leaving a ~160px cream vertical strip down the right edge of the page. In live the same dark section spans the full viewport width (edge-to-edge). Verified by pixel scan: clone dark background ends at x1279, live ends at x1439.
13-samples.fixHint: Make the dark CTA/footer wrapper full-bleed instead of capped at the ~1280px content container. Set width:100% (or full-bleed via width:100vw; margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw)) on the outer section so the dark background reaches the right edge.

13-samples.component: Two-column sample blocks (room photo + swatch grid)
13-samples.whatDiffers: The room-photo column renders ~9% smaller in the clone. Jake Arnold room image measures 500x579 in the clone vs 549x644 in live (same aspect), and the swatch grid is correspondingly wider (~775px clone vs ~740px live). The column split is ~38%/59% in the clone vs ~41%/55% in live. Repeated across all 10 sample blocks this accounts for the entire ~626px shorter page height and makes the imagery look slightly compressed on direct comparison.
13-samples.fixHint: Increase the image column width to match live's ratio (widen its flex-basis / grid-template-column so the photo column is ~41% of the row rather than ~38%), which restores image size and section heights.

21-contact.component: Full-bleed sections (hero image + dark "Your windows deserve this"/footer)
21-contact.whatDiffers: In the clone the full-width hero curtain image and the dark "Your windows deserve this" + footer section stop roughly 160px short of the right viewport edge, leaving a cream gutter running down the right side. In live both run edge-to-edge across the full viewport (100vw).
21-contact.fixHint: Make these breakout sections span the full viewport width (width:100vw with left:50%/translateX(-50%) breakout, or remove the max-width/right margin capping the wrapper to ~1280px). Ensure the hero image itself is width:100% of the full-bleed container.

21-contact.component: Hero banner image ("We're here to help")
21-contact.whatDiffers: The clone hero curtain image does not fill the hero container's height — a dark/near-black band shows along the bottom edge beneath the image (behind and below the "We're here to help" text). In live the image covers the entire hero with no dark strip.
21-contact.fixHint: Give the hero image object-fit:cover and height:100% of the hero container (or set the container height to match the image height) so the dark section background is not exposed below it.

21-contact.component: "Your windows deserve this." CTA buttons (SHOP NOW / ORDER SWATCHES)
21-contact.whatDiffers: The two buttons are stacked vertically (SHOP NOW above ORDER SWATCHES) in the clone. In live they sit side-by-side in a single centered horizontal row.
21-contact.fixHint: Set the button group container to flex-direction:row with a gap and justify-content:center instead of column, matching live's inline-row layout.

19-trade.component: Page content width / section backgrounds (hero + body sections)
19-trade.whatDiffers: Clone lays out the whole page in a left-anchored column that stops ~150px short of the right edge, leaving a persistent lighter empty band down the right side (boundary at ~x1275-1290 in the hero, 3-column grid, and 'Everything you need' section). The hero photo no longer reaches the right viewport edge (full-bleed lost) and the cream section backgrounds don't extend full width. Live content is centered/symmetric (~52px side margins), spans nearly the full 1440 width, and hero + colored sections are full-bleed.
19-trade.fixHint: Center the main content wrapper (mx-auto) with symmetric side padding instead of a narrow left-anchored max-width; make the hero image container and the colored section backgrounds full-bleed (w-full / 100vw) so no right-edge band appears.

19-trade.whatDiffers: Clone headline is ~13% smaller and wraps as 'For Designers, By' / 'Designers.'; live is larger and breaks after the comma: 'For Designers,' / 'By Designers.'
19-trade.fixHint: Increase the hero heading font-size to match live and/or constrain its max-width so the line break falls after the comma.

19-trade.component: Footer CTA buttons under 'Your windows deserve this.'
19-trade.whatDiffers: Clone stacks 'SHOP NOW' and 'ORDER SWATCHES' vertically (two rows); live shows them side by side on a single row.
19-trade.fixHint: Set the button group to flex-row with a gap (not column) and ensure the container is wide enough to hold both on one line.

19-trade.component: 'Apply to join Everhem Trade' APPLY NOW button
19-trade.whatDiffers: Clone button is too narrow so the label wraps to two lines ('APPLY' / 'NOW'), making a taller button; live keeps 'APPLY NOW' on one line.
19-trade.fixHint: Add white-space:nowrap plus adequate horizontal padding / min-width so the label stays on one line.

19-trade.whatDiffers: Clone shows a '→' submit arrow inside the 'your@email.com' field; live's field has no visible arrow affordance.
19-trade.fixHint: Match live by removing the arrow icon (or restyle the submit control to the plain underlined-field look live uses).

20-about-us.whatDiffers: Every full-width section in the clone is capped at ~1280px and pinned to the left, leaving a persistent ~160px WHITE gap down the right edge of the page. Visible on the hero image (ends ~x1280 with white to 1440), the bottom 3-image curtain gallery row, the cream 'The Everhem Way' band, the 'As Seen In' block, and the dark 'Your windows deserve this.' CTA band. Live renders all of these edge-to-edge (0–1440). Because the container is left-pinned, centered content (As Seen In heading, CTA heading/buttons) is shifted left of true page center.
20-about-us.fixHint: Make these full-bleed sections span the full viewport: give the hero image / section backgrounds width:100vw (or remove the max-w-[~1280px] cap on the outer page wrapper) and center inner content with mx-auto so backgrounds reach the right edge and centered blocks sit at the true 720px midline.

20-about-us.whatDiffers: Clone stacks the two buttons vertically (SHOP NOW on top, ORDER SWATCHES below). Live places them side-by-side in a single horizontal row.
20-about-us.fixHint: Set the button group to flex-direction:row (inline-flex with a gap) instead of column so SHOP NOW and ORDER SWATCHES sit next to each other.

20-about-us.whatDiffers: Clone wraps the logos 3+2 (Forbes / AD / Modern Luxury on row 1; domino / Homes & Gardens on row 2). Live fits 4 on row 1 (Forbes / AD / Modern Luxury / domino) with Homes & Gardens centered alone on row 2. Clone logos also render oversized (domino and Homes & Gardens noticeably larger than live).
20-about-us.fixHint: Reduce logo max-height/width (and/or the row gap) to match live and let the row use full width so all four fit on line 1 with Homes & Gardens centered on line 2.

20-about-us.whatDiffers: Live breaks 'Your window / treatment experts.' after 'window' (2 lines) and sits lower in the hero; clone breaks 'Your window treatment / experts.' after 'treatment' and sits higher.
20-about-us.fixHint: Constrain the hero heading column width to force the break after 'window' and match the lower vertical anchor position; largely resolves once the hero regains full-bleed width.
